Title: Vinod's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vinod - 33 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Hema - 28 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Anjali - 63 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Ajay - 43 years, general
Look: armour, a sword at the waist, thick moustache

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Vinod stands on the training ground. Hema and Ajay stand near him.]

Ajay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vinod practises sword fighting.]

Vinod (gently): "What happened?"

[Vinod draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Ajay: "And then?"

[Hema rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Ajay (laughing): "Good job, Hema!"

Scene 2: The forest - Day

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Hema: "This is amazing!"

[Vinod rides an elephant through the forest.]

Anjali: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Anjali and Hema stand near him.]

Anjali: "Let's begin."

[Vinod presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Anjali: "This is amazing!"

[Vinod is dying to see the new film.]

Hema: "What happened?"

[Vinod laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Vinod: "Hey, look at that!"

[Vinod coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Vinod: "What a day to remember!"
